description: Source code for a class 'quality_test' that performs various PEP-8 compliance checks on Python files within a specified module directory, including import placement, spacing, licensing, loop queries, sequence checks, boolean comparisons, and method placement inside loops.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs PEP-8 style and best practice checks on Python files within a module directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the quality_test object with standard parameters and thresholds.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Main method to run various style checks on Python files in the given module path.

methods.name: check_import
methods.description: Checks that imports are on separate lines and placed at the top of the file.

methods.name: check_licence
methods.description: Verifies presence and placement of copyright/license comments.

methods.name: check_loop
methods.description: Detects method calls placed inside loops which is discouraged.

methods.name: check_space
methods.description: Checks for spaces before punctuation like commas, semicolons, and colons.

methods.name: check_space_operator
methods.description: Checks for multiple spaces around operators.

methods.name: check_len
methods.description: Ensures sequences are checked with 'if seq:' rather than 'len(seq)'.

methods.name: check_boolean
methods.description: Detects boolean comparisons using '==' or '!=' with True or False.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the overall test result into a table.

methods.name: get_result_general
methods.description: Generates an HTML report of the detailed results.
